home.title: Quiz
home.subtitle: Test yourself on a deck. Questions are written from your own cards.

empty.title: No quizzes yet
empty.body: Make one from any deck. It takes a few seconds.

home.confirmTaken: Its {{runs, number}} sittings, the answers you gave, and their mistake-note entries go with it. This cannot be undone.
home.confirmUnused: Never taken. Only the questions are removed.

setup.title: New quiz
setup.subtitle: Pick a deck and a question type. You see the price before anything is spent.

typeHint.mcq: Four options. Marked the moment you answer, with an explanation of why — both free.
typeHint.short: A word or a phrase. Graded by AI, charged per answer.
typeHint.essay: A few sentences, graded against a rubric. The most demanding, and the most expensive.

setup.eligible: {{eligible, number}} of {{total, number}} cards can be quizzed

noEligible.title: None of these {{total, number}} cards can be quizzed
noEligible.body: A quiz has to know which field on the back of a card is the answer. Open the deck's template and mark that field as the main one.

setup.tooFewForMcq_one: Multiple choice draws its wrong options from other cards, so it needs at least four. This deck has {{count, number}}.
setup.tooFewForMcq_other: Multiple choice draws its wrong options from other cards, so it needs at least four. This deck has {{count, number}}.

run.empty: The questions in this set are gone — the cards they came from were deleted.
run.shortfall: {{made}} of the {{requested}} questions you asked for were made. The deck ran out of usable cards, or some cards could not carry this question type.

length.tooShort: At least {{min, number}} characters to grade

tally.withUngraded: {{correct, number}} right · {{wrong, number}} wrong · {{ungraded, number}} ungraded

result.nothingGradedBody: You haven't graded any answer in this sitting yet.
result.headline: {{correct, number}} right

error.AI_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: Not enough credit. Top up to keep going.
error.AI_PRICE_CHANGED: The price changed while you were deciding. Check it and try again.
error.AI_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: That is more than one quiz can hold. Ask for fewer questions.
error.QUIZ_NOT_ENOUGH_CARDS: This deck does not have enough quizzable cards.
error.AI_RATE_CAP: You have reached today's request limit. Try again tomorrow.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to that.
error.AI_EMPTY_RESULT: We could not write the questions. Nothing was charged. Please try again.
error.QUIZ_UNGRADEABLE: This answer cannot be graded — it is empty, or too long.
error.QUIZ_GRADE_REFUSED: Grading did not work, and you were not charged. Try again.
error.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.QUIZ_CARDS_TOO_SHORT: These cards are too short to build essay questions from — an essay is graded against terms taken from the card itself. Try short answer or multiple choice for this deck.
error.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI service is busy right now. Nothing was charged — try again in a moment.
error.AI_PROVIDER_DAILY_LIMIT: The daily AI limit for this app has been reached. Nothing was charged — it resets tomorrow.
error.AI_PROVIDER_BUSY: The AI service is busy. Nothing was charged — try again in a moment.
error.QUIZ_DIFFICULTY_UNAVAILABLE: That difficulty is not available for this question type. Pick another one.

level.unjudgeableNote: Some of this could not be judged, so it did not count against you.

mcq.1: The wrong options come from somewhere else entirely — recognising the subject is enough.
mcq.2: One of the three is a real trap; the other two are not close.
mcq.3: Every wrong option is a near-miss. You have to know the answer.

short.1: The question tells you what kind of answer to give.
short.2: No hint about the answer's form — just the question.
short.3: Asked from a different angle, so recognising the card is not enough.

essay.1: One thing to explain, in a sentence.
essay.2: The main point, plus one supporting detail from the card.
essay.3: Explain it and say where it stops applying.

mistakes.title: Mistakes
mistakes.emptyBody: Missed questions collect here as you take quizzes.

pricing.retakeMcq: The same questions, with the options reshuffled. Nothing is charged.
pricing.retakeWritten: The same questions again. The questions are already paid for, but grading is a fresh call and is charged every time.
pricing.genAllFree: Made from your free questions. Nothing is charged.
pricing.genFreeLeft: {{left, number}} of {{limit, number}} free questions left today (any type)

mcqAxis.category: They belong to different subjects entirely.
mcqAxis.component: One part differs — a term, a sign, a single word.
mcqAxis.condition: They apply under different conditions — both can be true.
mcqAxis.direction: The direction is reversed — who does what to whom.
mcqAxis.form: They look alike and mean different things.
mcqAxis.order: The steps come in a different order.
mcqAxis.scope: They cover different ranges — one is broader.

reason.question_unclear: I could not tell what it was asking
